summary: Mendocino NF lookout site in Tehama County: register dates a BC-301 cabin on a 20 ft enclosed tower to 1935; only the foundation remains. Not the Siskiyou Ball Mountain.

facts.status_note: Only the foundation remains at the site; removal date unknown
facts.agency: US Forest Service - Mendocino National Forest

events.note: Register date for the BC-301 cabin on a 20 ft enclosed timber tower; a 1936 notice conflicts (see resolved_conflicts)
August 8, 1936 notice: the lookout site, long used by the government, was bought from the Pickering Lumber company and a new station would be built there

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register gives 1935 for the cabin on a 20 ft enclosed tower. The 1936 notice says the site had been used for years and that a new station would be built, so it does not confirm 1935. No other source found settles it, so the story reports both.
The register names the Mendocino National Forest. The lookout history page that carries the 1936 notice heads the site as Shasta National Forest.

sources.title: Ball Mountain - FOREST LOOKOUTS

notes_for_editor: Do not merge with us-ca-ball-mountain (Siskiyou County, Klamath NF, US 1383). Search results for Ball Mountain mostly describe that Siskiyou tower and must not be used for this one. No staffing or access facts found, so none are recorded. The register's photo credit (Upper Lake Ranger District Collection) has no image URL, so no photo was added. Only two sources, so confidence is medium.
